hook: Heat a unit into a glass cannon, then choose the moment to Quench it into lasting stats.
loop: Heat units through board layout, taking hits and selling shop units.
Heat piles up as fight-only Attack on a few pieces.
Quench it into permanent stats, at the best rate at 10 Heat.

growth.line: Heat piles on one or two units each turn; Quenching at 10 Heat pays +3/+3 per Heat.

feel.early: Small Heat, fragile boards until Cold Water or Bucket.
feel.mid: Arrange bellows and anvils; melt sales into your carry.
feel.late: Chase 10 Heat for Grandmaster, or Atra's fight burst.

stars.why: The 10-Heat target gives the whole game a number to chase.
Quenching stops spending the fuel, so Quench payoffs fire every turn.
Extra lives paid in Heat, fighting Quench for the same fuel.

card_short.u01: When played: give a unit 2 Heat.
card_short.u02: Gains Heat when attacked and survives, twice a fight.
card_short.u03: When attacked, units behind it gain Heat, twice a fight.
card_short.u04: End of Turn: heats the units on the other row.
card_short.u05: Selling a hot unit: keep its Heat, gain 1 gold.
card_short.u06: Selling a unit adds its Attack as Heat to your hottest.
card_short.u07: End of Turn: hottest unit gains Heat per empty slot.
card_short.u08: When played: Quench a unit; its neighbours gain Heat.
card_short.u09: Units in front deal their Heat as damage after attacking.
card_short.u10: End of Turn: units in front gain half their Heat.
card_short.u11: End of Turn: units with no Heat gain 3 Heat.
card_short.u12: Other friendly units gain Heat when attacked and surviving.
card_short.u13: End of Turn: Quench the hottest unit behind; gold per 4.
card_short.u14: Start of Combat: hottest unit gains +2/+2 per Heat.
card_short.u15: Your Quenches leave half the Heat behind.
card_short.u16: Start of Turn: return a unit behind to hand, +3 Heat.
card_short.u17: Units with 4+ Heat regrow once a fight, losing half.
card_short.u18: Your units gain twice as much Heat.
card_short.u19: End of Turn: Quench units with 10+ Heat at +3/+3.
card_short.x01: Spell, 1 gold: Quench a unit early.

builds.name: One Masterpiece
builds.line: Pile Heat on one unit, aim for 10 and the Grandmaster.

builds.name: The hammer line
builds.line: Front row gets hotter when hit; Ottilie gives hot units second lives.

builds.name: The melt shop
builds.line: Buy units to sell them: Heat for your carry, plus gold.

liked: All three: every turn is a real choice, bank the Heat or keep heating.
Nutrisco, Konrad and Ottilie stood out; Grandmaster's 10-Heat target gives a clear goal.
worries: Watch: golden Nutrisco plus Grandmaster Quenches the same rising Heat every turn.
Watch: Crucible Keeper with Birds, and Konrad repeating other tribes' When played.
changed: Heat always lasts now, so 'permanently' came off the cards.
Warden Quench's gold capped at 2 a turn, stopping a golden Nutrisco loop.
Bellows Boy works from either row; Konrad's return is optional and keeps stats.
verdict: Rated 7 fun, 7 distinct, settled by all three reviewers, second of three; for players who like exact numbers and layouts.
